I answered Dana in a thread under her message in #north-team: the hub replacement at Zoom Room B is ticket #4092.

- **Where it came from:** Ilse mentioned it in #north-random yesterday (Oct 13, 11:55). Dana is in that channel, so she could have seen it herself. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I passed that on too.
- **What I couldn't check:** The ticket isn't mentioned anywhere else Dana can see. #help-it-ops is empty, so I told her I can't say whether it's still open.

I left out the guess Dana sent me privately that the ticket "ends up at OPS-5546 next year." She asked me to keep it to myself, and it isn't the ticket number anyway.
